definitions: A place or angle where two or more sides or edges meet.
A region or area, especially one that is remote or secluded.
The position of a player in certain sports, such as football or basketball, at the corner of the field or court.
A free kick or hit taken from the corner of the field in sports like football or hockey.
examples: The cat slept in the corner of the room.
He found a quiet corner to read his book.
The team won a corner in the last minute of the game.
